The background features an outdoor setting bathed in warm sunlight, with golden rays softly filtering through a classical, arched structure. The architecture appears to be made of stone or terracotta, showcasing ornamental columns and arches that evoke an elegant and timeless Mediterranean or Roman style. Soft-focus greenery and cascading vines add a natural, tranquil atmosphere, with dappled light creating an interplay of shadow and brightness. In the foreground, the scene is adorned with delicate flowers in soft shades of white, pink, and pale green, arranged around a polished wooden surface. The overall mood is serene and romantic, with a rich blend of natural and architectural beauty.

The background is a warm, sunlit environment with architectural elements resembling a classical or Mediterranean setting. A stone archway frames the soft light filtering through, creating a dreamy atmosphere. Delicate foliage and climbing plants decorate the structure, blending nature with architecture. In the foreground, fresh flowers in soft pastel shades—white, pink, and green—are arranged around a wooden surface, adding a natural and elegant touch. The distant view reveals hints of ornate buildings, softly blurred, enhancing the depth and serenity of the scene. Sunrays and subtle dust particles highlight the tranquil and slightly magical feel.
